svg.aria-label: App Factory: how the roles hand work to each other, from the idea to each built block
svg.title: App Factory: role flow
svg.text: routes · records state · never writes docs/code

g.text: 1 · You type /factory "idea"
The orchestrator reads .workflow/state.json and routes to the right phase.
2 · Brainstorm + grill, with you
Challenge, angles, MVP cut, then a grill on the draft → 00-brief locked · every answer → DECISIONS.md
3 · product-manager · deep
Reads the locked brief → 01-prd.md: FR/NFR with stable IDs and testable criteria.
4 · ux-designer · deep
→ 02-ux.md: flows, every screen, and every state (empty, error, offline).
5 · design-system ∥ architect
In parallel → tokens + components · stack, contracts, quality gate, ADRs.
6 · planner · deep
→ 05-plan.md + plan.json: milestones cut into one-session blocks, with dependencies.
7 · spec-reviewer · deep · fresh eyes
Traceability, contradictions, testability → READY, or up to 2 automatic fix rounds.
8 · Approval → freeze
Brief, PRD and UX are frozen (only /change reopens them) · tag spec-v1 · auto, or your gate.
9 · block-runner · fresh context
For each block: a new context picks the next ready block from plan.json.
10 · developer · standard (deep if complex)
Reads HANDOFF.md first, stays in scope → code + tests.
11 · verifier · fast
Runs the quality gate → PASS, or a 15-line digest back to the developer (≤ 2 rounds).
12 · code-reviewer · deep
Checks every criterion with file:line proof → PASS, or fixes back (≤ 2 rounds).
13 · doc-keeper → commit
Updates plan status and living docs, writes HANDOFF.md · commit feat(B04) · next block.
14 · Stuck? diagnostician · deep
After the escalation fails: a 2–4 option question for you · your answer → /factory resumes.
